title: The hamlet, a family needs a roof and food put by
about: `hamlet` with two laws of `conceive_check` in skills.rhai changed (skills_patch): `conceive_food` 8 (the two partners carry at least 8 portions of food between them) and `conceive_roof` true (one stands under a shelter or in a house). The shipped values (0, false) ask neither. What one carries is what one gathered or took: the more mouths share the bushes and the fishing spots, the harder a surplus is to put by.
